searches.query: latest research papers AI ML simplified
searches.answer: The latest research papers in AI and ML include "SimCLR" from February 2020, which simplifies contrastive learning, and "Idefics2" from April 2024, which improves OCR capabilities. From Morgan Stanley, notable papers include "Rethinking Langevin Thompson Sampling from A Stochastic Approximation Perspective" and "Average-Case Hardness of Parity Problems." The paper "Small Language Models are the Future" from 2025 argues that small language models (< 10B params) are the future for Agentic AI. Additionally, the Transformer model introduced in "Attention Is All You Need" has become foundational for many modern NLP systems.
